tagline.en: iOS developer building Flutter and Swift apps, and AI automation workflows.
tagline.id: iOS developer yang membangun aplikasi Flutter dan Swift, serta alur kerja otomasi AI.

bioShort.en: Bachelor of Informatics from Multi Data Palembang University (GPA 3.99/4.00), now a Junior iOS Developer at the Apple Developer Academy in Bali. Builds mobile applications with Flutter, Dart, and Swift, and previously shipped an attendance system used by staff at Indonesia's House of Representatives. Open to full-time mobile development roles.
bioShort.id: Sarjana Informatika Universitas Multi Data Palembang dengan IPK 3,99/4,00, kini Junior iOS Developer di Apple Developer Academy Bali. Membangun aplikasi mobile dengan Flutter, Dart, dan Swift, serta pernah mengembangkan sistem absensi yang dipakai staf Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Republik Indonesia. Terbuka untuk posisi full-time di pengembangan mobile.

bioLong.en:
Mobile developer with a Bachelor of Informatics from Multi Data Palembang University, graduating with a 3.99/4.00 GPA, and currently a Junior iOS Developer at the Apple Developer Academy in Bali. The undergraduate thesis was published as first-author research in Sinkron: Jurnal dan Penelitian Teknik Informatika (Vol. 10 No. 1, 2026), classifying Yogyakarta batik motifs at 98.36% weighted accuracy using MobileNet features with an SVM classifier. Works primarily in Flutter and Dart, and is now building depth in Swift and the Apple platform ecosystem. Also spent a semester on a student exchange programme at Dian Nuswantoro University in Semarang.

As a mobile development intern at the House of Representatives of the Republic of Indonesia (DPR RI), led the development of ABSATA, an attendance system for Member Administration Staff and Expert Staff, covering secure login, an informative dashboard, and realtime attendance monitoring, and contributed UI/UX work to the institution's LMS application. Earlier project work spans Laravel web applications, a React retail platform, the Flutter app Suwotify, and Filmu, a React Native movie app built on the TMDb API.

Teaching and organising run alongside the engineering work: assistant lecturer for three classes of 30+ students, a mathematics YouTube channel that grew past 5,000 subscribers, and an online competition organised for more than 1,500 participants. Holds eight national and regional awards in mathematics and programming competitions, including a gold medal at the National Numeracy Olympiad.
bioLong.id:
Mobile developer, Sarjana Informatika Universitas Multi Data Palembang dengan IPK 3,99/4,00, dan saat ini Junior iOS Developer di Apple Developer Academy Bali. Skripsinya terbit sebagai penulis pertama di Sinkron: Jurnal dan Penelitian Teknik Informatika (Vol. 10 No. 1, 2026), mengklasifikasikan motif batik Yogyakarta dengan akurasi terbobot 98,36% memakai fitur MobileNet dan classifier SVM. Terutama bekerja dengan Flutter dan Dart, serta sedang memperdalam Swift dan ekosistem platform Apple. Pernah mengikuti program pertukaran mahasiswa selama satu semester di Universitas Dian Nuswantoro, Semarang.

Sebagai magang mobile developer di Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Republik Indonesia (DPR RI), memimpin pengembangan ABSATA, sistem absensi untuk Staf Administrasi Anggota dan Tenaga Ahli, mencakup login yang aman, dashboard informatif, dan pemantauan absensi realtime, sekaligus berkontribusi pada desain UI/UX aplikasi LMS lembaga tersebut. Project sebelumnya meliputi aplikasi web berbasis Laravel, platform retail dengan React, aplikasi Flutter Suwotify, serta Filmu, aplikasi film berbasis React Native yang memanfaatkan API TMDb.

Kegiatan mengajar dan berorganisasi berjalan berdampingan dengan pekerjaan teknis: asisten dosen untuk tiga kelas berisi 30+ mahasiswa, kanal YouTube matematika dengan lebih dari 5.000 pelanggan, dan kompetisi daring yang diselenggarakan untuk lebih dari 1.500 peserta. Memiliki delapan penghargaan tingkat nasional dan regional di kompetisi matematika dan pemrograman, termasuk medali emas Olimpiade Numerasi Nasional.
